Title: To me it's strange that Sutton insists LLMs have no goal. It's clear they at least sort of have a go...
Author: Jake Koenig
Summary: To me it's strange that Sutton insists LLMs have no goal. It's clear they at least sort of have a goal of being helpful. Maybe in some ways deceptive or not robust. But at least in most conversations you'll predict best how they'll behave with that perspective
